article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Takalot, Talhandak and San: Several positions of terrorist groups struck down
article_manifest.original_title: Takalot, Talhandak et San : Plusieurs positions des groupes terroristes foudroyées
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, October 9 (AMAP)– The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) destroyed a vehicle containing war materiel northeast of Takalot and hit a major logistics point in the Talhandak area, as well as a base housing terrorist elements northeast of San, during air-land operations conducted Thursday, October 8 as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, according to the General Staff of the Armed Forces .

article_manifest.title: Niger: France expels two intelligence agents, one suspected of monitoring opponents
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : la France expulse deux agents de renseignement, l'un soupçonné de surveiller des opposants
article_manifest.summary: Tensions between France and Niger have been building since 2023. France has expelled two agents of the Nigerien intelligence services, reveals Le Monde on October 8, citing a French diplomatic source and a Nigerien source. One of the expelled officers was suspected of carrying out surveillance activities targeting opponents of the Niamey authorities present on French soil .

article_manifest.title: Takalot, Talhandak, San: FAMa surgical offensive against terrorist strongholds in the North and Center
article_manifest.original_title: Takalot, Talhandak, San : Offensive chirurgicale des FAMa contre les bastions terroristes dans le Nord et le Centre
article_manifest.summary: Takalot, Talhandak, San: FAMa surgical offensive against terrorist strongholds in the North and the Centre The General Staff of the Armed Forces announced, in a statement, the continuation of the offensive in the Eastern Theater as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. New air-land interventions were conducted by the Malian Armed Forces and their partners on Thursday, October 8, 2026 .

article_manifest.title: Road safety: 700 vehicles impounded in one morning in Ouagadougou
article_manifest.original_title: Sécurité routière : 700 engins mis en fourrière en une matinée à Ouagadougou
article_manifest.summary: This Thursday, October 8, 2026, the Ouagadougou municipal police conducted a vast control operation on the roads of the capital. Between 6:00 am and 10:00 am, this descent focused on compliance with the mandatory helmet resulted in the impoundment of 700 two-wheeled vehicles and three tricycles . After a two-year nationwide awareness-raising period, municipal and security authorities have resolutely shifted to a phase of repression.

article_manifest.title: When the home becomes a place of death: the series of domestic violence in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: Quand le foyer devient un lieu de mort : la série des violences conjugales au Mali
article_manifest.summary: The death of Racky Diaby, a young Malian presented in several recent publications as having been killed by her husband by firearms, brings to the fore a reality that is not new in Mali. Over the years, several women have lost their lives in their own homes, victims of violence committed by their spouses . Behind every case, there is a woman, a family and the same question: what to do when violence settles in a couple before it becomes irreversible?

article_manifest.title: Video said to show Mali army in Kidal after retaking city
article_manifest.original_title: Video said to show Mali army in Kidal after retaking city
article_manifest.summary: Recently published video is said to show Mali’s armed forces in Kidal after retaking the strategic northern city from Tuareg separatists. It would be a major symbolic gain for Mali’s military government, which lost the city to separatists six months ago.

article_manifest.title: No ransom paid for release of abducted corps members, says Imo CP
article_manifest.original_title: No ransom paid for release of abducted corps members, says Imo CP
article_manifest.summary: The Imo State Commissioner of Police, Audu Bosso, has said he is not aware of any ransom payment for the release of 20 prospective National Youth Service Corps members and a civilian abducted along the Owerri-Onitsha Road. The victims, who were abducted on October 1, 2026, were rescued from the Amokohia Uwe Forest in the Owerri West Local Government Area of the state after a coordinated operation by security agencies.

article_manifest.title: What Russia’s Africa Corps Is Actually Doing in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: What Russia’s Africa Corps Is Actually Doing in Mali
article_manifest.summary: - African Arguments, 7 October 2026 On September 14, 2026, more than 900 fuel tankers entered Bamako under military escort, the Malian government announced.

article_manifest.title: KIDAL: The FAMa consolidate their operational system in the city
article_manifest.original_title: KIDAL : Les FAMa consolident leur dispositif opérationnel dans la ville
article_manifest.summary: As part of the large-scale offensive conducted in the Eastern Theater, as part of Operation DOUGOUKOLOKO, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, consolidated their operational system in the city of KIDAL This operation comes following a campaign of intense airstrikes and several air-land operations carried out over the last few days, which have made it possible to neutralize several elements belonging to the FLA-JNIM terrorist coalition, while dealing significant blows, in depth, to their logistical capacities and their means of action.

article_manifest.title: Drama in Faladié: A young bride shot dead, her husband taken into custody
article_manifest.original_title: Drame à Faladié : Une jeune mariée tuée par balle, son époux placé en garde à vue
article_manifest.summary: DRAMA IN FALADIÉ: A YOUNG BRIDE SHOT DEAD, HER HUSBAND ARRESTED barely a few days after her wedding, HARKIA was found dead in the marital chamber. A firearm was reportedly discovered at the home of her husband, who was taken into custody. The tragedy occurred on the night of Tuesday, October 6 to Wednesday, October 7, 2026 at about 3 a.m., in Faladié .

article_manifest.title: Malian army recaptures Kidal with Russian support.. 'Liberation of Azawad' vows to continue fighting
article_manifest.original_title: الجيش المالي يستعيد كيدال بدعم روسي.. و"تحرير أزواد" تتوعد بمواصلة القتال
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army regained control of the strategic city of Kidal in the north of the country, after the withdrawal of the Front for the Liberation of Azawad from it following extensive air and ground operations carried out by the Malian forces with the support of the Russian "African Legion", in a development that represents an important symbolic gain for the military government in Bamako, but it does not seem decisive for the course of the ongoing conflict in the north of the country.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: Malian forces target supply networks in Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les forces maliennes ciblent les réseaux d’approvisionnement à Kidal
article_manifest.summary: As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their allies, have implemented several strategies to reduce the operational capabilities of opposing armed groups During the preparatory operations for the assault on Kidal, an active reconnaissance made it possible to identify several rear bases, storage facilities and fuel depots used by the armed groups.

article_manifest.title: Mali: after the takeover of Kidal, the FAMa launch a new operation
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : après la reprise de Kidal, les FAMa lancent une nouvelle opération
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by the Russian Africa Corps, are conducting a sweep operation in southern Kidal, after the city was retaken on October 6. According to the Africa Corps, armed combatants fled in a hurry as troops approached. Indeed, on October 6, the army entered the city of Kidal around 1 p.m., according to Malian security sources .

article_manifest.title: Me Mountaga Tall: we don't talk about it anymore?
article_manifest.original_title: Me Mountaga Tall : on n’en parle plus ?
article_manifest.summary: Five months after his alleged abduction, the silence around the fate of Me Mountaga Tall seems to settle. A situation that worries relatives, relatives and even human rights organizations. The name of Me Mountaga Tall, once very present in the debate and on social networks, seems to be gradually disappearing from the news.

article_manifest.title: PANDEF mourns victims of Ondo Air Force crash, seeks probe
article_manifest.original_title: PANDEF mourns victims of Ondo Air Force crash, seeks probe
article_manifest.summary: By Henry Umoru ABUJA — The Pan Niger Delta Forum (PANDEF), the apex socio-political body of the South-South geopolitical zone, has mourned the victims of the Nigerian Air Force (NAF) aircraft crash in the Igbokoda area of Ilaje Local Government Area of Ondo State. PANDEF also called for a thorough and comprehensive investigation to determine the circumstances that may have contributed to the crash and similar aviation tragedies.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: Allied Mali-Russian forces thwart terrorist ambushes on the outskirts of Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko: Les forces alliées Mali-Russie déjouent des embuscades terroristes aux abords de Kidal
article_manifest.summary: During their advance on Kidal, the joint units of Mali and Russia neutralized several ambush threats during reconnaissance patrols on the outskirts of the city. Several ambush locations were thus identified by the reconnaissance teams . According to the information gathered, the mission assigned to these terrorist groups was to delay the advance of the allied forces while the main forces of the terrorist coalition formed by the Fla (Frame for the Liberation of Azawad) and the JNIM (Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims) withdrew from Kidal.

article_manifest.title: The Nigerien Armed Forces sensitized on the general mobilization
article_manifest.original_title: Les Forces Armées Nigériennes sensibilisées sur la mobilisation générale
article_manifest.summary: Niamey, 08 Oct(ANP)- The Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, Brigadier General Mamane Sani KIAOU chaired, on Wednesday, October 07, 2026 at the Palais des Congrès in Niamey, an exchange meeting with the Commission responsible for the organization, preparation and monitoring of the implementation of the General Mobilization (COMOG) .

article_manifest.title: Mali: A return in trompe-l'oeil of the Fama in Kidal?
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Un retour en trompe-l'oeil des Fama à Kidal ?
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army and its Africa Corps allies announced that they had reinvested Kidal on Tuesday, October 6, 2026. The Fla (Azawad Liberation Front) and the Jnim (Support Group for Islam and Muslims) claim a tactical withdrawal to preserve the populations. Some think that this return bears the mark of Algiers.

article_manifest.title: Diffa/Goudoumaria: 250 t of millet for targeted free distribution in 104 villages
article_manifest.original_title: Diffa/Goudoumaria : 250 t de mil pour une distribution gratuite ciblée dans 104 villages
article_manifest.summary: Le Sahel.org

article_manifest.title: Kéniéba: An international network for money laundering and trafficking in cultural property dismantled
article_manifest.original_title: Kéniéba : Un réseau international de blanchiment d’argent et de trafic de biens culturels démantelé
article_manifest.summary: The Keniéba Gendarmerie Brigade recently arrested a young man from Faléa, Kéniéba commune, Kayes region, involved in an alleged international network of money laundering and trafficking in cultural property. The operation led to the seizure of 3 carved doors of great heritage value, which were allegedly stolen from Dékon, in the Bandiagara region, and intended for export to the West Source: L’Indicateur du Renouveau, Mali

article_manifest.title: Me Mountaga Tall: we don't talk about it anymore?
article_manifest.original_title: Me Mountaga Tall : on n’en parle plus ?
article_manifest.summary: Five months after his alleged abduction, the silence around the fate of Me Mountaga Tall seems to settle. A situation that worries relatives, relatives and even human rights organizations. The name of Me Mountaga Tall, once very present in the debate and on social networks, seems to be gradually disappearing from the news .

article_manifest.title: Military justice: Bamako Court sentences military and civilians for arms trafficking
article_manifest.original_title: Justice militaire : Le Tribunal de Bamako condamne des militaires et civils pour trafic d'armes
article_manifest.summary: Military justice: The Court of Bamako convicts military and civilians for arms trafficking The Military Court of Bamako held, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, its ordinary correctional hearing, presided over by Magistrate Assama Dolo. Five cases were on the docket, involving several military and civilian personnel for serious acts related to weapons and military discipline .

article_manifest.title: Mali: 900 Tankers Under Escort - What Africa Corps Actually Does in Mali
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: 900 Tankers Under Escort - What Africa Corps Actually Does in Mali
article_manifest.summary: On September 14, 2026, more than 900 fuel tankers entered Bamako under military escort, the Malian government announced. The figure sounds like a victory: the capital got its fuel. But the very need to herd 900 tankers into a single protected convoy is not a story about victory -- it is a story about how vulnerable the ordinary roads have become, the same roads through which Mali imports 95% of its fuel.

article_manifest.title: Kidal: Colonel Attaher Maiga and his men at the heart of the FAMa's takeover and securing of the city
article_manifest.original_title: Kidal : le Colonel Attaher Maïga et ses hommes au cœur de la reprise et de la sécurisation de la ville par les FAMa
article_manifest.summary: Kidal: Colonel Attaher Maïga, from the "red beret" to the command of the FAMa to consolidate the presence of the Malian State The truth of the weapons and the terrain prevailed over the opposing propaganda: Kidal is definitively and fully released, secured and reinstated in the bosom of the Republic of Mali . Colonel Attaher Maiga In the aftermath of this decisive step taken by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), it is a poignant testimony, full of assurance, authority and patriotism, delivered by Colonel Attaher A.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa intensify their air-land operations in the Talhandak, Kidal and Tessalit sectors
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa intensifient leurs opérations aéroterrestres dans les secteurs de Talhandak, Kidal et Tessalit
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 7 October 2026 – The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are resolutely continuing their missions to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the information provided by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, several aero-terrestrial actions were carried out on Wednesday, October 7, 2026 in different sectors of the Eastern Theater, in particular in the Talhandak areas, north of Kidal and in the Tessalit region .

article_manifest.title: Militant spillover from Mali raises mining-related security risks in Guinea
article_manifest.original_title: Militant spillover from Mali raises mining-related security risks in Guinea
article_manifest.summary: Executive summary Guinea has remained largely insulated from the militant violence affecting neighboring Mali. However, the security environment along the Mali-Guinea border has become increasingly fragile as the al-Qaeda-affiliated Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) has expanded and entrenched its presence across southern Mali. This expansion has brought militant activity closer to Guinea’s eastern border areas, where major industrial and artisanal mining sites are located.
